description: This file contains code for registering, validating, and unregistering a service worker in a React application, including environment checks, URL handling, and event listeners for service worker lifecycle events.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the service worker if in production environment and supported by the browser, with optional configuration callbacks.

methods.name: registerValidSW
methods.description: Handles the registration of a valid service worker and manages update lifecycle events.

methods.name: checkValidServiceWorker
methods.description: Checks if the service worker exists at the specified URL and reloads the page if not found.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the service worker if supported by the browser.
